title: The Public API does not return a customer's saved default Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a Public API key for the test organization, the Public API documentation, and a tool that sends API requests.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B.
custom_steps: 1. Send GET for customer A through the Public API.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The response is 200 and holds customer A.
  • No field in it gives customer A's saved default Bill To (customer B).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12321 (Story 19, IBS, invoice export and Public API)

  • S19-N3: “The Public API cannot set a Bill To or read a saved default.”
  • Out of Scope: “A saved default Bill To in the Public API. Set in ShopView only.”
